detached_structure.evidence: A small red-roofed structure sits just northwest of the main house, possibly a shed or attached addition.

signals.notes: Central house has a brown/reddish two-tone roof with some uneven color and shading, a paved driveway on the west side with one light-colored vehicle, and a dry, patchy lawn to the east and south, with mature trees crowding the north and west sides.
